scenarios.title: Navigate to Main Menu
scenarios.business_objective: Allow the user to access central navigation options via the main menu interaction.
preconditions: The application interface is loaded and visible.
steps: The user locates the main menu element (selector LOC-0004).
The user clicks the main menu interactive element.
scenarios.expected_result: The main menu interface is opened, presenting available navigation options.

scenarios.title: Deploy Blog Agent Service
scenarios.business_objective: Trigger deployment of the blog agent service or application workflow.
preconditions: The user is on the application control panel with deploy options active.
steps: The user locates the deploy interactive element (selector LOC-0003).
The user clicks the deploy button.
scenarios.expected_result: The deployment process for the blog agent service is successfully initiated.

scenarios.title: Stop Active Process
scenarios.business_objective: Halt an active execution or process within the system immediately.
preconditions: An automated task or blog generation process is currently running.
steps: The user locates the stop interactive element (selector LOC-0002).
The user clicks the stop button.
scenarios.expected_result: The active process or execution is terminated immediately.

scenarios.title: Jump to Section Heading
scenarios.business_objective: Enable direct navigation to a specific content heading within the blog view.
preconditions: The user is viewing a document or page containing structured section heading links.
steps: The user locates the link to heading interactive element (selector LOC-0008).
The user clicks the heading link.
scenarios.expected_result: The viewport navigates directly to the specified section heading.

scenarios.title: Interact with Generic UI Element
scenarios.business_objective: Trigger targeted interactive UI behavior on element selection.
preconditions: The target interactive element is displayed on the active page.
steps: The user identifies the general element with selector LOC-0001.
The user performs a click action on the element.
scenarios.expected_result: The system processes the user click and triggers the corresponding element event.
